parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy is offering 1 Wheat for 1 Brick. My hand is 1 Brick (B), 1 Wheat (Wh), and 2 Sheep (S). I need 1 Wood (W) and 1 Wheat (Wh) to build a settlement at Node 34. While I need Wheat, Brick is extremely rare right now (Hex 13 is blocked, and I had to bank-trade for this Brick). Trading away my only Brick for a common resource like Wheat, which Jimmy and Claude just received from the previous roll of 8 (and potentially 6 if they have it), is a bad deal. I should hold the Brick to trade for Wood or use it myself later, as it's the most valuable resource on the board currently. Jimmy is also a competitor for the same expansion area.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Jimmy's Wheat-for-Brick trade. Brick is too valuable to trade 1:1 for Wheat when others are producing Wheat and Brick is blocked. Still need 1 Wood and 1 Wheat for node 34.
parsed.say_outloud: ג'ימי, אתה רציני? הטיט הזה הוא כנראה הדבר הכי יקר על האי כרגע, ואתה מציע לי חיטה שכל השולחן הרגע קיבל? אם אתה רוצה טיט, תצטרך להציע משהו הרבה יותר מעניין מזה.
